::: {.positioning}
We quantify how farms, food systems and water users turn inputs and natural resources (land,
water, nutrients, climate) into outputs, and how policy, prices and weather shocks shift that
relationship.
:::

::: {.pillars}
::: {.pillar}
**One question**
Each case starts from a current policy debate and asks one narrow, answerable question.
:::

::: {.pillar}
**Public data**
Every number traces to a named dataset and access date, so anyone can check it.
:::

::: {.pillar}
**Open code**
Production frontiers, productivity, water pricing, climate risk: all in R, all on GitHub.
:::
:::
